description.value: Kelly & Carlos O'Bryan's is a lively Irish-themed neighborhood pub and restaurant occupying an iconic building in downtown New Westminster, one stop on a chain of BC locations. The venue features both indoor and outdoor patio seating, regular live music on the patio, trivia nights, karaoke, and a broad pub menu including a kids' menu — making it a sociable stop for groups of cyclists. Its central Columbia Street location puts it within easy reach of the New Westminster waterfront cycling routes.
